build_keypoint_head: build a keypoint head from config and input shape using the ROI_KEYPOINT_HEAD_REGISTRY
compute_keypoint_rcnn_loss: compute keypoint R-CNN loss from predicted logits, ground truth instances, and a normalizer
run_keypoint_rcnn_inference: run keypoint R-CNN inference to post-process heatmap logits into per-instance (x, y, score) keypoints
create_BaseKeypointRCNNHead: create a BaseKeypointRCNNHead subclass with configurable num_keypoints, loss_weight, and loss_normalizer
create_KRCNNConvDeconvUpsampleHead: create a KRCNNConvDeconvUpsampleHead with conv layers, transpose conv, and bilinear upsampling for keypoint prediction
